provider: 华为云空间 / HUAWEI Mobile Cloud

free_tier.stated: 5 GB free, split between 基础服务 and 会员服务. Paid tiers commonly 50 GB, 200 GB and 2 TB. A 2 TB carpool is priced at CNY 698 split six ways at CNY 120 each

retention.stated: 基础服务 holds contacts, SMS and notes with no fixed size; photos and video need 会员服务. No retention clock published

egress.terms: No documented cap, but the service is sync-oriented and offers no public sharing of the drive

tooling: two distinct APIs. The consumer one is reverse-engineered at driveapis.cloud.huawei.com.cn behind an OAuth bearer token, and RzdPai/Huawei_Cloud_Webdav exposes it as WebDAV, which is the useful part. KooDrive is a separate enterprise product with official documentation and must not be conflated with it
chaining: A WebDAV bridge exists, so it chains like any drive, but 5 GB free is 400 accounts per terabyte and the free tier is per HUAWEI ID rather than per device. Non-mainland IDs often cannot buy a plan at all

limits.value: 5 GB is the free tier total, which is the cap in practice
the plan purchase fails for a HUAWEI ID registered in a country where the cloud storage plan is not available

identity_cost.detail: a HUAWEI ID registered in a country where the plan is sold. The vendor's own support page says the purchase prompt fails otherwise

reliability_note: The terms now split 基础服务, unmetered for contacts, SMS and notes, from 会员服务, metered for photos, video and app data. The unmetered half holds no bulk data. Free-space farming exists but is territory-locked to app-install tasks on Huawei handsets

evidence.proved: a live portal served by Huawei Services Hong Kong; a global portal exists but the storage product is region-gated
table row 华为云服务, 5G free, no upload limit, no review, no sharing, no speed limit, login required
the plan purchase fails when the HUAWEI ID's registration country does not support the plan
a WebDAV service over the Huawei cloud drive API, '可将华为云盘映射为本地磁盘'
a 2 TB carpool at CNY 698 for six people at CNY 120 each, 330 GB per person

price_per_tb_month: 2 TB at CNY 698/yr is about USD 4.1/TB/month, and it is often unpurchasable on a non-mainland HUAWEI ID
binding_note: 5 GB free, and the plan that would fix it is often unpurchasable from outside the mainland, so the quota closes it before the region gate is reached.
notes: What stops a user is 5 GB free plus a purchase path that fails for a non-mainland ID.
